## AS IS — Current state

### Runtime and language

- **Language**: PHP ^8.3 (`composer.json`), runtime PHP 8.5 (Sail `runtimes/8.5` in `compose.yaml`); TypeScript 6.0.3 (frontend)
- **Framework**: Laravel 13 (`laravel/framework` ^13.17, locked v13.39.0)

| Component | Version | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Admin panel | Filament v5.11.0 | `composer.lock` `filament/filament` |
| AI SDK | `laravel/ai` v1.3.0 | `composer.lock` |
| MCP client | `laravel/mcp` v1.1.2 | `composer.lock`, `app/Services/McpClient.php` |
| WebSocket server | `laravel/reverb` v1.12.0 | `compose.yaml` service `reverb` |
| SPA auth | `laravel/sanctum` v4.3.3 | `bootstrap/app.php` `statefulApi()` |
| Vector type | `pgvector/pgvector` v0.2.2 | `memory_embeddings.embedding vector(1536)` |
| Database | PostgreSQL 18 + pgvector | image `pgvector/pgvector:pg18` |
| Cache/queue/session | Redis | `compose.yaml` `redis`, `config/queue.php` |
| Object storage | S3 via `league/flysystem-aws-s3-v3` ^3.0; RustFS locally | `compose.yaml` `rustfs` |
| SPA | Vue 3.5.44, vue-router ^4.6.4, Pinia 4.1.0, vue-i18n ^9.14.5 | `package.json`, `node_modules` |
| Realtime client | laravel-echo ^2.6.3 + pusher-js ^8.6.0 | `resources/js/lib/echo.ts` |
| Rendering | markdown-it ^15.0.3 + DOMPurify ^3.4.17 | `resources/js/lib/markdown.ts` |
| Bundler | Vite 8.3.5, `@vitejs/plugin-vue` ^6.0.10, Tailwind ^4.0.0, `vite-plugin-pwa` ^2.0.0 | `vite.config.ts` |
| Dev env | Laravel Sail ^1.69 (Docker) | `compose.yaml` |

- Test env (`phpunit.xml`): `DB_DATABASE=testing`, `REDIS_DB=2`, `REDIS_CACHE_DB=3`, `SESSION_DRIVER=array`, `MAIL_MAILER=array`.
- Run: `vendor/bin/sail test --filter=Name`; `vendor/bin/sail npm run test`; `vendor/bin/sail npm run typecheck` (`README.md`).
- CI: none (no `.github/workflows`, no `.gitlab-ci.yml`).

### External integrations

| System | Client wiring |
|---|---|
| AI providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepSeek, Gemini, Groq, xAI, Mistral, Ollama, Azure, ElevenLabs drivers) | `laravel/ai`; DB rows `ai_providers` (encrypted `api_key`) registered at runtime by `app/Services/ProviderRegistry.php`; `*_API_KEY` env are fallback in `config/ai.php` |
| MCP servers | `Laravel\Mcp\Client::web($url)->withTimeout()` in `app/Services/McpClient.php`; `MCP_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` (default 15) |
| REST / webhook tools | `Http::acceptJson()->timeout()` in `app/Tools/HttpToolHandler.php` |
| Reverb | `config/reverb.php`, `config/broadcasting.php`; SPA `resources/js/lib/echo.ts` |
